page_title: FUL 1-2 AST | Fulham v Aston Villa 17/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Lewis Smith is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' A clumsy foul by Adama Traore (Fulham) and Lewis Smith blows his whistle.
90+4' Harry Wilson (Fulham) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
90+4' Unai Emery decides to make a substitution. Youri Tielemans will be replaced by Tim Iroegbunam (Aston Villa).
90+3' Adama Traore (Fulham) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.

90+1' Adama Traore (Fulham) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the right post, but Emiliano Martinez shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' The foul by Sasa Lukic (Fulham) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Lewis Smith.
89' Lewis Smith shows a yellow card to Timothy Castagne (Fulham) for a tough tackle.
89' Here comes a substitution. Sasa Lukic (Fulham) is brought on as a substitute for Joao Palhinha.
89' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
86' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) sees a yellow card from Lewis Smith after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
85' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
84' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Alex Iwobi (Fulham), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
83' Poor challenge! Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) is penalised for tripping and Lewis Smith blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Fulham, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
82' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. Aston Villa are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
81' Unai Emery has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) replacing Leon Bailey.
81' That's the end of the game for Alex Moreno, who is replaced by Lucas Digne (Aston Villa).
81' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Aston Villa was in an offside position.

80' What an opportunity that was! The ball rebounded out to Harry Wilson (Fulham), whose shot from the edge of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.

79' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Emiliano Martinez guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
78' Adama Traore (Fulham) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
77' The corner is swung in but Fulham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
75' Marco Silva has decided to substitute Tim Ream and he is replaced by Calvin Bassey (Fulham).
75' Andreas Pereira comes off the pitch to be replaced by Adama Traore (Fulham).
75' Rough tackle by Leon Bailey (Aston Villa). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Fulham are awarded a free kick.
75' Fulham couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
74' Lewis Smith shows a yellow card to Alex Moreno (Aston Villa), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
72' Harry Wilson (Fulham) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
72' It seemed like Andreas Pereira (Fulham) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
71' Alex Moreno (Aston Villa) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Lewis Smith saw the whole situation. Fulham will take a free kick.
70' Harry Wilson (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
69' The resulting corner from Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is cleared by the defence.
69' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Fulham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

66' Nice move, nice attempt! Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
65' Bernd Leno is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Leon Bailey (Aston Villa). Easy save!
64' Marco Silva has decided to make a change. Harry Wilson (Fulham) replaces Bobby De Cordova-Reid.
63' 1 - 2 Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and sends a low drive past the goalkeeper.
63' Leon Bailey passes to Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa), but he produces a wild shot from the edge of the box which goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.

62' Close! Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) takes the resulting free kick from a promising positon, but his effort flies inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.

61' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. Aston Villa are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
60' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
59' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
59' An attempted cross from Antonee Robinson (Fulham) is cleared.
56' 0 - 2 Goal! A great through ball by Youri Tielemans sets up Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the left side of the goal. 0:2.

56' Issa Diop (Fulham) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the right side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Emiliano Martinez makes a comfortable save.
55' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
55' Handball! A player from Aston Villa handled the ball. Fulham get a free kick.
54' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Emiliano Martinez intercepts the ball.
53' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) commits a rough challenge and Lewis Smith blows his whistle for an infringement. Aston Villa are awarded the free kick.
52' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
50' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but Emiliano Martinez comes off his line to gather the ball.
48' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) sends a long ball in, but Emiliano Martinez comfortably gathers the ball.
47' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Willian comes off for Alex Iwobi (Fulham).
46' The second half has just started.
45+9' Lewis Smith blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+9' The resulting set piece from Aston Villa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45+8' Aston Villa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. Aston Villa have a corner.
45+7' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) fails to turn the rebound in from a promising position. The goalkeeper pulls off a superb save and denies his effort. Aston Villa earn a corner.
45+6' A cross from Andreas Pereira (Fulham) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
45' 7 additional min. will be played.
45' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham), but it's just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
45' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) will deliver the corner kick.
43' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Aston Villa due to an offside in the build-up play.
42' The Aston Villa players halt their celebrations as referee Lewis Smith makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
40' Alex Moreno (Aston Villa) finds the back of the net with a superb finish!
40' Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick.
40' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick.

39' What a save from Emiliano Martinez! Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.

39' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
38' A raking crossfield pass from Matty Cash (Aston Villa) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
37' Clement Lenglet (Aston Villa) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
35' Clement Lenglet (Aston Villa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
32' Lewis Smith shows the yellow card to John McGinn (Aston Villa) for a heavy challenge.

32' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
32' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
31' Willian (Fulham) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.

29' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is found in space by a decent pass, and he immediately hits a rocket of a shot at goal that clips the top of the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
27' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
27' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
25' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Antonee Robinson (Fulham).
23' 0 - 1 Goal! Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:1.
22' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Fulham players look gutted.
22' Wait! Referee Lewis Smith immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
22' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Tim Ream (Fulham) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
20' Free kick. Fulham will probably just try to cross the ball in from here. Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) commits a rough foul. Lewis Smith stops the game and makes a call.
17' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

16' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) makes room to connect with a cross, but his strike from the penalty spot isn't accurate at all and the ball goes well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
14' The Fulham players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
13' Issa Diop (Fulham) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
12' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
11' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

11' Alex Moreno (Aston Villa) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Aston Villa will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

8' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Lewis Smith stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. That's a free kick to Aston Villa.
6' A player from Fulham takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Aston Villa.
5' Alex Moreno (Aston Villa) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

4' The corner is swung in and Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker over the bar from close in. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
4' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
3' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) has a goal ruled out for offside!

The players are on the pitch and Fulham will have the kick-off.
